section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the method for a study where 105 participants (45 female, 60 male) were recruited from Amazon's MTurk. The mean age was 34.28 years, and 80.8% of participants identified as White. Participants completed the SBAS-2 after reading and imagining six brief scenarios.
section_summary.evidence_source: Participants and procedure. Participants were recruited from Amazon's MTurk following the general procedure described in Study 1. Potential participants were told that the study was intended to explore the way social interactions affect feelings about the body and compensation was $1.00. The final sample included 105 participants (45 female and 60 male) ranging in age from 18 to 69 (M=34.28, SD=10.72). Racial breakdown was as follows: 80.8% White, 9.6% Asian American, 6.7% African American, 1.9% Latina/Latino, and 1.0% multiracial. Participants were presented with six brief scenarios, which are provided in Appendix B. For each one, they were instructed to imagine themselves in the situation. These scenarios were presented in random order, and participants completed the SBAS-2 after reading and imagining each situation. Cronbach's alpha for the SBAS-2 in this study ranged from .97 to .98.
